title: DeLonge: Iraq war linked to groups connected with nonhuman entities

tellings.quote: early interviews before anyone knew who his advisers were, he was talking about how some of the things that we did in Iraq may have been related to certain groups of people there who were connected with certain nonhuman entities and were helping them proliferate.

plain: The musician turned UFO researcher Tom DeLonge once suggested that some of what the United States did in Iraq after 2003 may have been tied to groups of people there who were "connected with certain nonhuman entities and were helping them proliferate." The researcher Jason Simosa repeats this to Michels from DeLonge's early interviews, given before anyone knew who DeLonge's advisers were. If true, it would mean a war was partly about beings that are not human.
